item.title: AIIMS Bhopal Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 45 Posts
item.description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for 45 Assistant Professor posts on a contractual basis. Eligible candidates can submit their applications by e-mail within 10 days from the date of publication of the advertisement on the Institute's website. The application form and detailed notification are available on the official website.

item.title: DAVV M.A Result 2026 Out - Check 2nd Grade List Online @ dauniv.ac.in
item.description: DAVV has released the Semester II grade list for M.A Economics (2YDC) and M.A Sociology (2YDC) on 01-10-2026. Check the official results page, the details confirmed so far and how to find your result.

item.title: RITES Expert Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Port Planning, Transport Planner and More Posts
item.description: RITES Limited has invited applications for the Recruitment 2026 empanelment of Experts, including Port Planning Expert, Port Related Logistics Expert and Transport Planner Expert positions. The number of vacancies is not specified in the REOI. Eligible candidates can submit their applications by e-mail, with applications received up to 08.10.2026

item.title: FACT Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
item.description: The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited (FACT) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for empanelment of candidates for Engineer (IT). Eligible candidates can submit their online applications on or before 14.10.2026, followed by submission of the hard copy by Speed Post or Registered Post by 22.10.2026. The application form and detailed notification are available on the official website, fact.co.in. Candidates with the prescribed B.Tech/BE qualification and completed Apprenticeship training from the FACT Training & Development Centre can apply.
